title: Fix the multiple inclusion
hints: Click *Check* once and read the error: which type is defined twice, and through which chain of `#include`s?
Each header needs `#ifndef SOMETHING_HPP` / `#define SOMETHING_HPP` at the top and `#endif` at the bottom (or `#pragma once`).
Guard *every* header, not only `money.hpp`: the tests also include `order.hpp` twice.
